[bold #D75FFF]◆ EPIC sase-9s[/bold #D75FFF]
[dim]  Title: [bold #D7AFFF][/dim]Detached background tasks and a single epic-launch path[/bold #D7AFFF]
[dim]   Goal: [#D7D7AF][/dim]Approving an epic plan always launches `sase bead work` as one [/#D7D7AF]
[dim]         [#D7D7AF][/dim]durable, session-independent "detached" background task — from the [/#D7D7AF]
[dim]         [#D7D7AF][/dim]TUI, from Telegram, from the CLI, or with nothing interactive [/#D7D7AF]
[dim]         [#D7D7AF][/dim]running at all — and that task is legible, killable, and beautiful [/#D7D7AF]
[dim]         [#D7D7AF][/dim]on every surface that shows background tasks.[/#D7D7AF]
[dim]   Path: [#87AFFF][/dim]sase/repos/plans/202607/[bold #87AFFF][/#87AFFF]detached_epic_launch.md[/bold #87AFFF]
[dim]  1 [bold #AF87FF][/dim]◆ [bold #D7AFFF][/bold #AF87FF]Break the agents_sync to ace.tui import cycle[/bold #D7AFFF]                 [bold black on #87D7FF] small  [/bold black on #87D7FF]
    [#AF87FF]import_cycle[dim] · [dim][/dim]no dependencies[/#AF87FF][/dim]

    [#D7D7AF]section: move the agent value types the sync backend needs out of the [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]TUI package, restore `import sase.agents_sync` in non-TUI processes, and[/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]add a layering guard so a backend module can never import `sase.ace` [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]again.[/#D7D7AF]
[dim]  2 [bold #AF87FF][/dim]◆ [bold #D7AFFF][/bold #AF87FF]Accept the detached task kind in the Rust core[/bold #D7AFFF]                [bold black on #87D7FF] small  [/bold black on #87D7FF]

    [#D7D7AF]section: widen the background-task store's kind validation to admit [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]`detached`, cover it with Rust tests, and rebuild the Python binding.[/#D7D7AF]
[dim]  3 [bold #AF87FF][/dim]◆ [bold #D7AFFF][/bold #AF87FF]Resolve the epic launch workspace without provider env vars[/bold #D7AFFF]   [bold black on #87D7FF] small  [/bold black on #87D7FF]

    [#D7D7AF]`agent_project_file` alone.[/#D7D7AF]
[dim]  4 [bold #AF87FF][/dim]◆ [bold #D7AFFF][/bold #AF87FF]Detached task submission, ownership, and filtering[/bold #D7AFFF]            [bold black on #87D7FF] small  [/bold black on #87D7FF]
    [#AF87FF]runner[dim] · [dim][/dim]after core_kind[/#AF87FF][/dim]
